method: Eight fixed-pose source pairs add quarter/three-quarter closed eyes and parted/medium-open mouths. Full generated portraits are preserved byte-identically; runtime uses registered local native-scale crops and fixed upper-lip translations. No synthetic morph, scaling or opacity crossfade is used to create expression frames. Each source can provide separate left eye, right eye and mouth states. Selection and actual measured geometry are in manifest.json. Prior side candidates are retained to document rejected or corrected source stages.

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one precise intermediate 2D VTuber expression painting, same native 1122 x 1402 canvas.
Input images: Image 1 is the neutral EDIT TARGET and immutable registration reference; image 2 supports the existing half-closed-eye/small-open-mouth endpoint; image 3 supports the existing fully-closed-eye/wide-open-mouth endpoint. Produce ONE full portrait, not a sheet.
Keep the exact character identity, 画面左转 · 角色右转 head pose, head size, near/far perspective, face contour, nose, eyebrows, short blue-gray hair including every strand crossing the eyes, ears, neck, jacket, white shirt, lighting, palette and background of IMAGE 1.
Change ONLY both upper eyelids and the mouth interior, creating a genuinely newly drawn intermediate frame:
EYELIDS: 25% closed, approximately halfway between the fully open eyes of image 1 and half-closed eyes of image 2. Both apertures must be visibly more open than image 2, about 75% of the neutral vertical opening. Keep eye corners, lower lids and eyeballs stationary. MOUTH: lips just parted in a very narrow gentle slit, only about 10–14 native pixels tall, visibly smaller than image 2; retain the original soft smile width and subtle low-saturation line.
The upper-lip reference remains fixed at approximately (461,654) on the neutral image, and the opening unfolds DOWNWARD. Do not lift the mouth, change the face silhouette, introduce thick lips, lipstick, glossy highlights, stronger blush, eyebrow motion or new decorations. Keep exactly the existing iris shape/color/center behind the eyelids; do not resize eyes or move pupils. Do not blend two eyes/lips on top of each other; draw one crisp edge per eyelid or lip. Preserve composition and original illustration style. No text, labels, borders, cat ears, accessories, extra objects, or collage.
